items.name: Dåstrup Sleepover 2018
items.information:
Husk at læs hver eneste fane. Den danske version stå øverst hver gang, og så vil der være en engelsk version under den.
Der vil desuden også være mulighed for at overnatte fra fredag aften, til søndag morgen!
**Husk at du må tage maks en gæst med!**

_______

Please make sure to read all the the tabs. English versions will be in the bottom of every tab, under the Danish version.
As seen in the name of the competition, you will have the possibility, to sleep at the venue, from Friday evening, to Sunday morning!
**Remember that you can at most bring one guest!**

items.name: Michigan 2018

venue.name: Palmer Commons and Michigan League
venue.address: 911 N University Ave, Ann Arbor, MI 48104
venue.details: Friday/Saturday - Palmer Commons, Sunday - Michigan League; see the "Home" tab for more info.

items.information:
There is a registration fee of $15 and a limit of 220 competitors. Registration will begin on June 22nd, 2018 at 11:59pm EST and it will close on August 5th, 2018 at 11:59pm EST or when the competitor limit is reached.

This competition is open to everyone and spectators may attend for free.

Michigan Cubing Club members may compete for free. Contact us after you have registered.

Visit the competition website to see full registration, schedule, and travel details.

items.name: CubingUSA Northwest Championship 2018
items.information: Northwest Championships 2018 is open to all competitors in the USA and the world, and prizes will be given to the top competitors. Residents of Washington, Oregon, Idaho, Montana, Wyoming, and Alaska are also eligible to win the title of Northwest Champion.
